evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~443-446 °C, implausibly high and slowly drifting versus column temps of 63-75 °C
Reflux and distillate flows near zero/noisy (0-1.6 L/h) while FYI702 stays fixed at ~6.4, inconsistent with the measured flows
Mid-column temperatures oscillate cyclically (~66-75 °C) with no net separation trend over 20 min
Top/condenser temps essentially frozen at 63.8/63.4/63.3 °C with negligible variation

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature/thermocouple check and verification of the flow transmitters versus FYI702 (and of PY23 setpoint control) to distinguish sensor faults from actual absence of boilup/reflux.
